name: Reactive stablecoin-inflow FADE short (4h, late money into an extended up-move)
rationale: MECHANISM: the best-documented empirical fact is that issuance/inflows LAG price — flows react to demand, not cause it (Wei VAR: no causal issuance->BTC). A big stablecoin_net_flow_usd inflow arriving AFTER an already-extended up-move marks late, reactive, trend-chasing money — a crowding/exhaustion tell. Entry: large inflow spike coinciding with STRETCHED price (bb_z high AND ret_Nd strongly positive) — short/fade. Other side = momentum retail piling in at the top via freshly-moved stables; the reactive flow is structurally late and mean-reverts. DISCONFIRMER: requires inflow to coincide with EXTENDED price; if the fade also works when inflow coincides with neutral/oversold price, it is just a generic overbought short and the flow feature is decorative. Also fails if net-of-fees the short cannot overcome crypto's structural long-drift — a weak inflow signal (corr<0.3) is unlikely to deliver a reliable reversal.
catalyst: reactive stablecoin inflow into an already-stretched 4h up-move
